name: open_deals_no_task_list
description: The individual open deals with no next action booked — deal name, stage, owner, contact, value and how long it has been open — biggest value first. Use for 'which deals have nothing booked', 'give me the list to chase', 'show me the forgotten deals', 'what needs a follow-up booked'. Check open_tasks_on_contact before presenting any deal as forgotten: above zero means somebody HAS scheduled something, just against the customer rather than this deal, so it is a linkage fix rather than a chase — say so rather than listing it as neglected. Deals open a long time with nothing booked and a high value are the strongest case for chasing; lead with those. For the counts by stage rather than the list, use open_deals_no_task_by_stage.

params.name: min_value
params.description: Only deals worth at least this much. Use for 'the big ones with nothing booked'.

params.name: min_days_open
params.description: Only deals open at least this many days. Use for 'anything sitting over a month with nothing booked'.

params.name: owner
params.description: Narrow to one rep by name.

params.name: stage
params.description: Only deals sitting in this stage.
